def _add_elo_to_games(
    raw_games: pd.DataFrame,
    base_rating: float = 1500.0,
    k_factor: float = 20.0
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    각 게임별로 pre-game Elo rating (home/away)을 계산해서
    'elo_home', 'elo_away' 컬럼을 추가한다.
    """
    df = raw_games.copy()

    # 날짜 정렬
    if not np.issubdtype(df["date"].dtype, np.datetime64):
        df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
    df = df.sort_values("date").reset_index(drop=True)

    ratings: dict[str, float] = {}
    elo_home_list = []
    elo_away_list = []

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        home = row["home_team"]
        away = row["away_team"]

        Rh = ratings.get(home, base_rating)
        Ra = ratings.get(away, base_rating)

        # pre-game Elo 기록
        elo_home_list.append(Rh)
        elo_away_list.append(Ra)

        # ✅ 스코어 없는 경기면 Elo 업데이트는 하지 않는다
        hs = row.get("home_score", np.nan)
        aws = row.get("away_score", np.nan)
        if pd.isna(hs) or pd.isna(aws):
            continue

        # 실제 결과 (home win = 1, home lose = 0)
        if row["home_score"] > row["away_score"]:
            Sh, Sa = 1.0, 0.0
        elif row["home_score"] < row["away_score"]:
            Sh, Sa = 0.0, 1.0
        else:
            Sh, Sa = 0.5, 0.5

        # 기대 승률
        Eh = 1.0 / (1.0 + 10.0 ** ((Ra - Rh) / 400.0))
        Ea = 1.0 - Eh

        # 업데이트
        Rh_new = Rh + k_factor * (Sh - Eh)
        Ra_new = Ra + k_factor * (Sa - Ea)

        ratings[home] = Rh_new
        ratings[away] = Ra_new

    df["elo_home"] = elo_home_list
    df["elo_away"] = elo_away_list

    return df


def _build_team_level_panel(raw_games: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = raw_games.copy()
    if not np.issubdtype(df["date"].dtype, np.datetime64):
        df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])

    # ✅ MUST: team_panel 만들기 전에 점수 없는 경기 제거
    df = df.dropna(subset=["home_score", "away_score"]).copy()
    df = df.sort_values("date").reset_index(drop=True)

    has_elo = "elo_home" in df.columns and "elo_away" in df.columns

    # -----------------------------
    # 1) 홈 팀 레코드
    # -----------------------------
    cols_home = ["game_id", "date", "season", "home_team", "home_score", "away_score"]
    if has_elo:
        cols_home.append("elo_home")

    home_df = df[cols_home].copy()
    home_df.rename(
        columns={
            "home_team": "team",
            "home_score": "points_for",
            "away_score": "points_against",
        },
        inplace=True,
    )
    home_df["is_home"] = 1

    if has_elo:
        home_df["elo_like"] = home_df["elo_home"]
        home_df.drop(columns=["elo_home"], inplace=True)

    # -----------------------------
    # 2) 어웨이 팀 레코드
    # -----------------------------
    cols_away = ["game_id", "date", "season", "away_team", "away_score", "home_score"]
    if has_elo:
        cols_away.append("elo_away")

    away_df = df[cols_away].copy()
    away_df.rename(
        columns={
            "away_team": "team",
            "away_score": "points_for",
            "home_score": "points_against",
        },
        inplace=True,
    )
    away_df["is_home"] = 0

    if has_elo:
        away_df["elo_like"] = away_df["elo_away"]
        away_df.drop(columns=["elo_away"], inplace=True)

    # -----------------------------
    # 3) team × game 패널 + 기본 지표
    # -----------------------------
    team_panel = pd.concat([home_df, away_df], ignore_index=True)
    team_panel.sort_values(["team", "date"], inplace=True)

    team_panel["win"] = (team_panel["points_for"] > team_panel["points_against"]).astype(int)
    team_panel["point_diff"] = team_panel["points_for"] - team_panel["points_against"]

    # -----------------------------
    # 4) advanced rating merge  (ROBUST + FALLBACK)
    # -----------------------------
    def _norm_team_name(x: object) -> str:
        if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and np.isnan(x)):
            return ""
        s = str(x).strip()
        s = " ".join(s.split())
        return s
    
    # -----------------------------
    # ✅ Canonical team name system (NO MISSING TEAMS)
    # -----------------------------

    # NBA 30 teams official-ish full names (canonical output)
    CANON_TEAMS = {
        "Atlanta Hawks",
        "Boston Celtics",
        "Brooklyn Nets",
        "Charlotte Hornets",
        "Chicago Bulls",
        "Cleveland Cavaliers",
        "Dallas Mavericks",
        "Denver Nuggets",
        "Detroit Pistons",

        "Phoenix Suns",

        "San Antonio Spurs",
        "Toronto Raptors",
        "Utah Jazz",
        "Washington Wizards",
    }

    # Extra alias -> canonical full name
    TEAM_ALIASES_TO_CANON = {
        # LA teams (your logs show "LA Clippers")
        "LA Clippers": "Los Angeles Clippers",
        "Los Angeles Clippers": "Los Angeles Clippers",
        "L.A. Clippers": "Los Angeles Clippers",

        "New Orleans": "New Orleans Pelicans",
        "Pelicans": "New Orleans Pelicans",

        "San Antonio": "San Antonio Spurs",
        "Spurs": "San Antonio Spurs",

        "Phoenix": "Phoenix Suns",
        "Suns": "Phoenix Suns",

        "Portland": "Portland Trail Blazers",
        "Trail Blazers": "Portland Trail Blazers",
        "Blazers": "Portland Trail Blazers",

        "Indiana": "Indiana Pacers",

        "Milwaukee": "Milwaukee Bucks",

        "Miami": "Miami Heat",
        "Heat": "Miami Heat",

        "Orlando": "Orlando Magic",
        "Magic": "Orlando Magic",

        "Memphis": "Memphis Grizzlies",
        "Grizzlies": "Memphis Grizzlies",

        "Kings": "Sacramento Kings",

        "Utah": "Utah Jazz",
        "Jazz": "Utah Jazz",

        "Denver": "Denver Nuggets",
        "Nuggets": "Denver Nuggets",

        "Dallas": "Dallas Mavericks",
        "Mavericks": "Dallas Mavericks",
        "Mavs": "Dallas Mavericks",

        "Houston": "Houston Rockets",
        "Rockets": "Houston Rockets",

        "Chicago": "Chicago Bulls",
        "Bulls": "Chicago Bulls",

        "Boston": "Boston Celtics",
        "Celtics": "Boston Celtics",

        "Atlanta": "Atlanta Hawks",
        "Hawks": "Atlanta Hawks",

        "Toronto": "Toronto Raptors",
        "Raptors": "Toronto Raptors",
    }

    def _canon_team(x: object) -> str:
        """
        Convert anything (abbr/full/alias) into one of CANON_TEAMS if possible.
        """
        t = _norm_team_name(x)

        # 1) ABBR -> FULL (uses your ABBR_TO_FULL defined below; safe even if not found)
        # NOTE: ABBR_TO_FULL may not exist yet at function definition time, but will exist at runtime.
        try:
            t = ABBR_TO_FULL.get(t, t)
        except NameError:
            pass

        # 2) alias -> canonical
        t = TEAM_ALIASES_TO_CANON.get(t, t)

        # 3) final guard: if it already matches canonical list, keep; else keep as-is (and we will print it)
        return t




    ABBR_TO_FULL = {
        "ATL": "Atlanta Hawks", "BOS": "Boston Celtics", "BKN": "Brooklyn Nets", "BRK": "Brooklyn Nets",
        "CHA": "Charlotte Hornets", "CHO": "Charlotte Hornets", "CHI": "Chicago Bulls", "CLE": "Cleveland Cavaliers",
        "DAL": "Dallas Mavericks", "DEN": "Denver Nuggets", "DET": "Detroit Pistons", "GSW": "Golden State Warriors",
        "GS": "Golden State Warriors", "HOU": "Houston Rockets", "IND": "Indiana Pacers", "LAC": "Los Angeles Clippers",
        "LAL": "Los Angeles Lakers", "MEM": "Memphis Grizzlies", "MIA": "Miami Heat", "MIL": "Milwaukee Bucks",
        "MIN": "Minnesota Timberwolves", "NOP": "New Orleans Pelicans", "NO": "New Orleans Pelicans",
        "NYK": "New York Knicks", "OKC": "Oklahoma City Thunder", "ORL": "Orlando Magic",
        "PHI": "Philadelphia 76ers", "PHX": "Phoenix Suns", "PHO": "Phoenix Suns", "POR": "Portland Trail Blazers",
        "SAC": "Sacramento Kings", "SAS": "San Antonio Spurs", "SA": "San Antonio Spurs",
        "TOR": "Toronto Raptors", "UTA": "Utah Jazz", "WAS": "Washington Wizards", "WSH": "Washington Wizards",
    }

    team_panel["team"] = team_panel["team"].apply(_canon_team)

    adv_panel = build_team_advanced_stats_panel(df)

    print("[DEBUG][ADV] adv_panel is None?", adv_panel is None)
    print("[DEBUG][ADV] adv_panel rows =", 0 if adv_panel is None else len(adv_panel))
    if adv_panel is not None and not adv_panel.empty:
        print("[DEBUG][ADV] adv_panel cols =", list(adv_panel.columns))

        adv_tmp = adv_panel.copy()

        # -----------------------------
        # team key normalize (핵심 FIX)
        # - adv_panel은 team_name이 더 믿을만한 경우가 많아서 우선 사용
        # -----------------------------
        # -----------------------------
        # team key normalize (핵심 FIX)
        # - adv_panel은 team_name이 더 믿을만한 경우가 많아서 우선 사용
        # - 최종적으로 team은 CANON 30팀 풀네임으로 강제
        # -----------------------------
        if "team_name" in adv_tmp.columns and adv_tmp["team_name"].notna().any():
            adv_tmp["team"] = adv_tmp["team_name"].apply(_canon_team)
        elif "team" in adv_tmp.columns:
            adv_tmp["team"] = adv_tmp["team"].apply(_canon_team)
        else:
            adv_tmp["team"] = ""



        
        print("[DEBUG][ADV] team_panel team sample:", team_panel["team"].dropna().unique()[:5])
        print("[DEBUG][ADV] adv_tmp team sample:", adv_tmp["team"].dropna().unique()[:5])




        # keep only needed cols (if exist)
        rating_cols = [c for c in ["off_rating", "def_rating", "net_rating"] if c in adv_tmp.columns]
        base_cols = ["team"] + rating_cols
        has_game_id = "game_id" in adv_tmp.columns

        # --- Case 1: game_id exists -> try strict merge on (game_id, team)
        if has_game_id:
            adv_tmp["game_id"] = pd.to_numeric(adv_tmp["game_id"], errors="coerce")
            team_panel["game_id"] = pd.to_numeric(team_panel["game_id"], errors="coerce")

            keep_cols = ["game_id", "team"] + rating_cols
            adv_tmp = adv_tmp[keep_cols].dropna(subset=["game_id", "team"]).drop_duplicates(["game_id", "team"])
            
            
            # ✅ NO-MISSING-TEAMS checks (정말 before merge)
            tp_teams = set(team_panel["team"].dropna().unique())
            adv_teams = set(adv_tmp["team"].dropna().unique())

            unknown_tp = sorted([t for t in tp_teams if t not in CANON_TEAMS])
            unknown_adv = sorted([t for t in adv_teams if t not in CANON_TEAMS])

            print("[DEBUG][ADV] team_panel unique teams =", len(tp_teams), "adv_tmp unique teams =", len(adv_teams))
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] overlap teams =", len(tp_teams & adv_teams))
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] unknown team_panel (non-canon) =", unknown_tp[:20])
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] unknown adv_tmp (non-canon) =", unknown_adv[:20])

        
            
            

            team_panel = team_panel.merge(adv_tmp, how="left", on=["game_id", "team"])
            
     



            
            # 🔍 DEBUG: game_id 체계 비교
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] team_panel game_id sample:",
                team_panel["game_id"].dropna().astype(int).head(3).tolist())
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] adv_tmp game_id sample:",
                adv_tmp["game_id"].dropna().astype(int).head(3).tolist())
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] game_id ranges tp/adv:",
                (team_panel["game_id"].min(), team_panel["game_id"].max()),
                (adv_tmp["game_id"].min(), adv_tmp["game_id"].max()))

            print("[DEBUG][ADV] coverage(off_rating) =",
                team_panel.get("off_rating", pd.Series(dtype=float)).notna().mean())


            cov = team_panel["off_rating"].notna().mean() if "off_rating" in team_panel.columns else 0.0
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] strict merge coverage(off_rating) =", cov)

            # --- Fallback if strict merge fails (likely different game_id system)
            if cov < 0.01:
                print("[DEBUG][ADV] strict merge 0% → fallback to TEAM-ONLY merge (season-level adv)")
                # collapse to team-level mean (or last)
                adv_team = adv_panel.copy()
                if "team_name" in adv_team.columns and adv_team["team_name"].notna().any():
                    adv_team["team"] = adv_team["team_name"].apply(_canon_team)
                elif "team" in adv_team.columns:
                    adv_team["team"] = adv_team["team"].apply(_canon_team)
                else:
                    adv_team["team"] = ""


                adv_team = adv_team[base_cols].dropna(subset=["team"]).groupby("team", as_index=False)[rating_cols].mean()

                adv_team = adv_team.rename(columns={c: f"season_{c}" for c in rating_cols})
                team_panel = team_panel.merge(adv_team, how="left", on=["team"])

                # 편의상 off_rating/def_rating/net_rating에 season_값을 채워 넣기
                for c in rating_cols:
                    base = c
                    season_c = f"season_{c}"
                    if base not in team_panel.columns:
                        team_panel[base] = team_panel[season_c]
                    else:
                        team_panel[base] = team_panel[base].fillna(team_panel[season_c])

                cov2 = team_panel["off_rating"].notna().mean() if "off_rating" in team_panel.columns else 0.0
                print("[DEBUG][ADV] fallback TEAM-ONLY coverage(off_rating) =", cov2)

        # --- Case 2: no game_id -> it’s team-level already, merge on team
        else:
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] adv_panel has NO game_id → TEAM-ONLY merge")
            adv_team = adv_tmp[base_cols].dropna(subset=["team"]).groupby("team", as_index=False)[rating_cols].mean()
            adv_team = adv_team.rename(columns={c: f"season_{c}" for c in rating_cols})

            team_panel = team_panel.merge(adv_team, how="left", on=["team"])

            # off_rating/def_rating/net_rating로도 채워서 downstream 코드 그대로 동작
            for c in rating_cols:
                base = c
                season_c = f"season_{c}"
                if base not in team_panel.columns:
                    team_panel[base] = team_panel[season_c]
                else:
                    team_panel[base] = team_panel[base].fillna(team_panel[season_c])

            cov = team_panel["off_rating"].notna().mean() if "off_rating" in team_panel.columns else 0.0
            print("[DEBUG][ADV] TEAM-ONLY coverage(off_rating) =", cov)

    else:
        print("[DEBUG][ADV] adv_panel is empty or None")





    # -----------------------------
    # 5) 팀별 rolling / 시즌 누적
    #    ✅ FIX: min_periods=1 로 데이터 삭제(초반 NaN) 크게 줄임
    # -----------------------------
    def _add_rolling(g: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        g = g.sort_values("date").copy()

        # ✅ PRE-GAME로 만들기: 현재 경기 결과를 절대 쓰지 않도록 1경기 lag
        win_l1 = g["win"].shift(1)
        pdiff_l1 = g["point_diff"].shift(1)
        pf_l1 = g["points_for"].shift(1)
        pa_l1 = g["points_against"].shift(1)
        is_home_l1 = g["is_home"].shift(1)

        # ---- 10-game rolling (PRE-GAME) ----
        g["rolling_win_rate_10"] = win_l1.rolling(10, min_periods=1).mean()
        g["rolling_point_diff_10"] = pdiff_l1.rolling(10, min_periods=1).mean()
        g["rolling_points_for_10"] = pf_l1.rolling(10, min_periods=1).mean()
        g["rolling_points_against_10"] = pa_l1.rolling(10, min_periods=1).mean()
        g["rolling_home_ratio_10"] = is_home_l1.rolling(10, min_periods=1).mean()

        # ---- 5-game rolling (PRE-GAME) ----
        g["rolling_win_rate_5"] = win_l1.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
        g["rolling_point_diff_5"] = pdiff_l1.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
        g["rolling_points_for_5"] = pf_l1.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
        g["rolling_points_against_5"] = pa_l1.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
        g["rolling_home_ratio_5"] = is_home_l1.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()

        # ✅ 시즌 누적도 PRE-GAME (shift 1)
        # season_games: 지금 경기 포함 X → 이전까지 몇 경기 했는지
        g["season_games"] = g.groupby("season").cumcount()

        g["season_wins"] = g.groupby("season")["win"].shift(1).fillna(0).groupby(g["season"]).cumsum()
        g["season_win_rate"] = np.where(g["season_games"] > 0, g["season_wins"] / g["season_games"], np.nan)

        g["season_point_diff_cum"] = g.groupby("season")["point_diff"].shift(1).fillna(0).groupby(g["season"]).cumsum()
        g["season_point_diff_avg"] = np.where(g["season_games"] > 0, g["season_point_diff_cum"] / g["season_games"], np.nan)

        # ✅ advanced rating도 PRE-GAME rolling
        for col in ["off_rating", "def_rating", "net_rating"]:
            if col in g.columns:
                col_l1 = g[col].shift(1)
                g[f"rolling_{col}_10"] = col_l1.rolling(10, min_periods=1).mean()
                g[f"rolling_{col}_5"] = col_l1.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()

        return g



    team_panel = team_panel.groupby("team", group_keys=False).apply(_add_rolling)

    # -----------------------------
    # 6) rest_days, back-to-back
    # -----------------------------
    team_panel["prev_date"] = team_panel.groupby("team")["date"].shift(1)
    team_panel["rest_days"] = (team_panel["date"] - team_panel["prev_date"]).dt.days
    team_panel["is_back_to_back"] = (team_panel["rest_days"] == 1).astype(int)
    
    # -----------------------------
    # 6.5) 4-in-6 (NEW)
    #   - 해당 경기 날짜 포함, 최근 6일(오늘 포함) 안에 치른 경기 수 >= 4
    # -----------------------------
    def _add_4in6(g: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        g = g.sort_values("date").copy()

        # date -> datetime64 보장
        dts = pd.to_datetime(g["date"]).values.astype("datetime64[D]")

        # rolling count in 6-day window (inclusive)
        # 구현: 각 index i에 대해 [date_i - 5, date_i] 범위 안 경기 수
        counts = np.zeros(len(g), dtype=int)
        j = 0
        for i in range(len(g)):
            # window start = date_i - 5 days
            start = dts[i] - np.timedelta64(5, "D")
            while dts[j] < start:
                j += 1
            counts[i] = i - j + 1

        g["games_in_last_6_days"] = pd.Series(counts, index=g.index).shift(1)
        g["is_4in6"] = (g["games_in_last_6_days"].fillna(0) >= 4).astype(int)

        return g

    team_panel = team_panel.groupby("team", group_keys=False).apply(_add_4in6)




    print(f"[DEBUG][TEAM_PANEL] rows={len(team_panel)}, teams={team_panel['team'].nunique()}")
    print("[DEBUG][TEAM_PANEL] any missing points_for/against?", team_panel[["points_for", "points_against"]].isna().any().to_dict())

    return team_panel


def build_training_dataset(raw_games: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, list[str]]:
    """
    raw_games → game 단위 학습 데이터셋 (home 관점)

    ✅ FIX 목표:
      1) 점수 없는 경기만 제거 (훈련용 target 때문)
      2) feature NaN 때문에 대량 dropna 하지 않음
         → feature는 평균으로 채워서 데이터량을 올드와 비슷하게 유지
    """
    rg = raw_games.copy()

    print(f"[DEBUG][TRAIN] raw_games rows = {len(raw_games)}")
    missing_scores = raw_games[["home_score", "away_score"]].isna().any(axis=1).sum()
    print(f"[DEBUG][TRAIN] games with missing score = {missing_scores}")

    if not np.issubdtype(rg["date"].dtype, np.datetime64):
        rg["date"] = pd.to_datetime(rg["date"])

    # ✅ 점수 없는 경기만 제거 (target 생성 불가)
    rg = rg.dropna(subset=["home_score", "away_score"]).copy()
    print(f"[DEBUG][TRAIN] after dropna(score) rows = {len(rg)}")

    # 1) Elo 추가
    rg = _add_elo_to_games(rg)

    # 2) 팀 패널 생성
    team_panel = _build_team_level_panel(rg)

    df = rg.copy()

    # -----------------------------
    # 3) 홈 팀 스탯 merge
    # -----------------------------
    home_stats = team_panel.add_suffix("_home").rename(
        columns={
            "team_home": "home_team",
            "date_home": "date",
            "game_id_home": "game_id",
            "season_home": "season",
        }
    )

    home_cols_base = [
        "game_id",
        "home_team",
        "date",
        "rolling_win_rate_10_home",
        "rolling_point_diff_10_home",
        "season_win_rate_home",
        "season_point_diff_avg_home",
        "rest_days_home",
        "is_back_to_back_home",
        "elo_like_home",
        "rolling_off_rating_10_home",
        "rolling_def_rating_10_home",
        "rolling_net_rating_10_home",
        "season_games_home",
        "rolling_win_rate_5_home",
        "rolling_point_diff_5_home",
        "rolling_points_for_5_home",
        "rolling_points_against_5_home",
        "rolling_home_ratio_5_home",
        "is_4in6_home",
        "games_in_last_6_days_home",


    ]
    home_cols = [c for c in home_cols_base if c in home_stats.columns]

    df = df.merge(home_stats[home_cols], on=["game_id", "home_team", "date"], how="left")

    # -----------------------------
    # 4) 어웨이 팀 스탯 merge
    # -----------------------------
    away_stats = team_panel.add_suffix("_away").rename(
        columns={
            "team_away": "away_team",
            "date_away": "date",
            "game_id_away": "game_id",
            "season_away": "season",
        }
    )

    away_cols_base = [
        "game_id",
        "away_team",
        "date",
        "rolling_win_rate_10_away",
        "rolling_point_diff_10_away",
        "season_win_rate_away",
        "season_point_diff_avg_away",
        "rest_days_away",
        "is_back_to_back_away",
        "elo_like_away",
        "rolling_off_rating_10_away",
        "rolling_def_rating_10_away",
        "rolling_net_rating_10_away",
        "season_games_away",
        "rolling_win_rate_5_away",
        "rolling_point_diff_5_away",
        "rolling_points_for_5_away",
        "rolling_points_against_5_away",
        "rolling_home_ratio_5_away",
        "is_4in6_away",
        "games_in_last_6_days_away",

    ]
    away_cols = [c for c in away_cols_base if c in away_stats.columns]

    df = df.merge(away_stats[away_cols], on=["game_id", "away_team", "date"], how="left")

    # -----------------------------
    # 5) target
    # -----------------------------
    df["target"] = (df["home_score"] > df["away_score"]).astype(int)

    # -----------------------------
    # 6) diff 피처
    # -----------------------------
    df["diff_rolling_win_rate_10"] = df["rolling_win_rate_10_home"] - df["rolling_win_rate_10_away"]
    df["diff_rolling_point_diff_10"] = df["rolling_point_diff_10_home"] - df["rolling_point_diff_10_away"]
    df["diff_season_win_rate"] = df["season_win_rate_home"] - df["season_win_rate_away"]
    df["diff_season_point_diff_avg"] = df["season_point_diff_avg_home"] - df["season_point_diff_avg_away"]
    df["diff_elo_like"] = df["elo_like_home"] - df["elo_like_away"]
    df["diff_rolling_win_rate_5"] = df["rolling_win_rate_5_home"] - df["rolling_win_rate_5_away"]
    df["diff_rolling_point_diff_5"] = df["rolling_point_diff_5_home"] - df["rolling_point_diff_5_away"]
    df["diff_is_4in6"] = df["is_4in6_home"] - df["is_4in6_away"]



    if "rolling_off_rating_10_home" in df.columns and "rolling_off_rating_10_away" in df.columns:
        df["diff_rolling_off_rating_10"] = df["rolling_off_rating_10_home"] - df["rolling_off_rating_10_away"]
    if "rolling_def_rating_10_home" in df.columns and "rolling_def_rating_10_away" in df.columns:
        df["diff_rolling_def_rating_10"] = df["rolling_def_rating_10_home"] - df["rolling_def_rating_10_away"]
    if "rolling_net_rating_10_home" in df.columns and "rolling_net_rating_10_away" in df.columns:
        df["diff_rolling_net_rating_10"] = df["rolling_net_rating_10_home"] - df["rolling_net_rating_10_away"]

    # -----------------------------
    # 7) feature_cols
    # -----------------------------
    feature_cols: list[str] = [
        "rolling_win_rate_10_home",
        "rolling_win_rate_10_away",
        "rolling_point_diff_10_home",
        "rolling_point_diff_10_away",
        "season_win_rate_home",
        "season_win_rate_away",
        "season_point_diff_avg_home",
        "season_point_diff_avg_away",
        "rest_days_home",
        "rest_days_away",
        "is_back_to_back_home",
        "is_back_to_back_away",
        "elo_like_home",
        "elo_like_away",
        "diff_rolling_win_rate_10",
        "diff_rolling_point_diff_10",
        "diff_season_win_rate",
        "diff_season_point_diff_avg",
        "diff_elo_like",
        "rolling_win_rate_5_home",
        "rolling_win_rate_5_away",
        "rolling_point_diff_5_home",
        "rolling_point_diff_5_away",
        "diff_rolling_win_rate_5",
        "diff_rolling_point_diff_5",
        "is_4in6_home",
        "is_4in6_away",
        "diff_is_4in6",

    ]

    extra_cols = [
        "rolling_off_rating_10_home",
        "rolling_off_rating_10_away",
        "rolling_def_rating_10_home",
        "rolling_def_rating_10_away",
        "rolling_net_rating_10_home",
        "rolling_net_rating_10_away",
        "diff_rolling_off_rating_10",
        "diff_rolling_def_rating_10",
        "diff_rolling_net_rating_10",
    ]
    for c in extra_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            feature_cols.append(c)
            
    feature_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c in df.columns]
    
    # -----------------------------
    # 8) 최종 train_df
    #    ✅ FIX: 대량 dropna 제거 → 평균으로 채움
    # -----------------------------
    train_df = df[
        ["game_id", "date", "season", "home_team", "away_team", "home_score", "away_score", "target",
         "season_games_home", "season_games_away"]
        + feature_cols
    ].copy()

    # 숫자형으로 강제
    for c in feature_cols:
        train_df[c] = pd.to_numeric(train_df[c], errors="coerce")

    # feature 평균으로 impute (데이터량 유지)
    fill_map = {c: float(train_df[c].mean()) for c in feature_cols}
    train_df = train_df.fillna(fill_map)

    train_df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(train_df["date"]).dt.date
    return train_df, feature_cols


def build_today_dataset(
    raw_games: pd.DataFrame,
    today_games: pd.DataFrame,
    today: _date,
):
    if raw_games.empty or today_games.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(), []

    # ---------------------------
    # 0) today_games 정규화
    # ---------------------------
    tg = today_games.copy()
    
    
    # ✅✅✅ [ADD HERE] SAFE ABBR extraction block
    def _extract_abbr_from_obj(x):
        if isinstance(x, dict):
            return x.get("abbreviation")
        return None

    if "home_team_abbr" not in tg.columns:
        if "home_team" in today_games.columns:
            tg["home_team_abbr"] = today_games["home_team"].apply(_extract_abbr_from_obj)
        else:
            tg["home_team_abbr"] = None

    if "away_team_abbr" not in tg.columns:
        if "away_team" in today_games.columns:
            tg["away_team_abbr"] = today_games["away_team"].apply(_extract_abbr_from_obj)
        elif "visitor_team" in today_games.columns:
            tg["away_team_abbr"] = today_games["visitor_team"].apply(_extract_abbr_from_obj)
        else:
            tg["away_team_abbr"] = None

    tg["home_team_abbr"] = tg["home_team_abbr"].astype(str).str.upper().replace({"NONE": np.nan, "NAN": np.nan})
    tg["away_team_abbr"] = tg["away_team_abbr"].astype(str).str.upper().replace({"NONE": np.nan, "NAN": np.nan})

    print("[DEBUG][TODAY] abbr null rate:",
          tg["home_team_abbr"].isna().mean(),
          tg["away_team_abbr"].isna().mean())
    
    
    
    
    

    if "game_id" not in tg.columns and "id" in tg.columns:
        tg["game_id"] = tg["id"]

    if "date" in tg.columns:
        tg["date"] = pd.to_datetime(tg["date"]).dt.date
    else:
        tg["date"] = today

    def _extract_full_name(x):
        if isinstance(x, dict):
            return x.get("full_name")
        return x

    if "home_team" in tg.columns:
        tg["home_team"] = tg["home_team"].apply(_extract_full_name)

    if "away_team" not in tg.columns and "visitor_team" in tg.columns:
        tg["away_team"] = tg["visitor_team"].apply(_extract_full_name)
    elif "away_team" in tg.columns:
        tg["away_team"] = tg["away_team"].apply(_extract_full_name)
        
        
    
  


 

    # ---------------------------
    # 1) raw_games + Elo
    # ---------------------------
    rg = raw_games.copy()
    if not np.issubdtype(rg["date"].dtype, np.datetime64):
        rg["date"] = pd.to_datetime(rg["date"])

    print(f"[DEBUG][TODAY] raw_games rows = {len(raw_games)}")
    missing_scores = raw_games[["home_score", "away_score"]].isna().any(axis=1).sum()
    print(f"[DEBUG][TODAY] games with missing score = {missing_scores}")

    # ✅ 과거 점수 없는 경기만 제거
    rg = rg.dropna(subset=["home_score", "away_score"]).copy()
    print(f"[DEBUG][TODAY] after dropna(score) rows = {len(rg)}")

    rg = _add_elo_to_games(rg)

    if "season" not in tg.columns:
        tg["season"] = rg["season"].max()

    latest_season = rg["season"].max()
    tg["season"] = tg["season"].apply(lambda s: latest_season if s > latest_season else s)

    # ---------------------------
    # 2) 팀 패널
    # ---------------------------
    team_panel = _build_team_level_panel(rg)

    team_panel = team_panel.sort_values(["team", "date"])
    last_rows = team_panel.groupby("team").tail(1).copy()
    last_rows.rename(columns={"date": "last_game_date"}, inplace=True)
    
    # ✅ 오늘(today) 기준 4-in-6 재계산 (last_rows는 last game 기준이라 오차 가능)
    cutoff = (pd.to_datetime(today) - pd.Timedelta(days=5)).normalize()
    tmp6 = team_panel[pd.to_datetime(team_panel["date"]) >= cutoff].copy()

    games6 = tmp6.groupby("team")["game_id"].count()
    last_rows["games_in_last_6_days_today"] = last_rows["team"].map(games6).fillna(0).astype(int)
    last_rows["is_4in6_today"] = (last_rows["games_in_last_6_days_today"] >= 4).astype(int)

    # 기존 컬럼명 유지해서 아래 merge 로직 안 깨지게 덮어쓰기
    last_rows["games_in_last_6_days"] = last_rows["games_in_last_6_days_today"]
    last_rows["is_4in6"] = last_rows["is_4in6_today"]



    last_rows["rest_days_today"] = (pd.to_datetime(today) - last_rows["last_game_date"]).dt.days
    last_rows["is_back_to_back_today"] = (last_rows["rest_days_today"] == 1).astype(int)

    base_keep_cols = [
        "team",
        "season",
        "rolling_win_rate_10",
        "rolling_point_diff_10",
        "season_win_rate",
        "season_point_diff_avg",
        "elo_like",
        "rest_days_today",
        "is_back_to_back_today",
        "rolling_off_rating_10",
        "rolling_def_rating_10",
        "rolling_net_rating_10",
        "rolling_win_rate_5",
        "rolling_point_diff_5",
        "is_4in6",
        "games_in_last_6_days",

    ]
    keep_cols = [c for c in base_keep_cols if c in last_rows.columns]
    snap = last_rows[keep_cols].copy()

    home_stats = snap.add_suffix("_home").rename(columns={"team_home": "home_team", "season_home": "season"})
    away_stats = snap.add_suffix("_away").rename(columns={"team_away": "away_team", "season_away": "season"})

    df = tg.copy()
    df = df.merge(home_stats, how="left", on=["home_team", "season"])
    df = df.merge(away_stats, how="left", on=["away_team", "season"], suffixes=("_home", "_away"))

    df["diff_rolling_win_rate_10"] = df["rolling_win_rate_10_home"] - df["rolling_win_rate_10_away"]
    df["diff_rolling_point_diff_10"] = df["rolling_point_diff_10_home"] - df["rolling_point_diff_10_away"]
    df["diff_season_win_rate"] = df["season_win_rate_home"] - df["season_win_rate_away"]
    df["diff_season_point_diff_avg"] = df["season_point_diff_avg_home"] - df["season_point_diff_avg_away"]
    df["diff_elo_like"] = df["elo_like_home"] - df["elo_like_away"]
    df["diff_rolling_win_rate_5"] = df["rolling_win_rate_5_home"] - df["rolling_win_rate_5_away"]
    df["diff_rolling_point_diff_5"] = df["rolling_point_diff_5_home"] - df["rolling_point_diff_5_away"]
    df["diff_is_4in6"] = df["is_4in6_home"] - df["is_4in6_away"]



    if "rolling_off_rating_10_home" in df.columns and "rolling_off_rating_10_away" in df.columns:
        df["diff_rolling_off_rating_10"] = df["rolling_off_rating_10_home"] - df["rolling_off_rating_10_away"]
    if "rolling_def_rating_10_home" in df.columns and "rolling_def_rating_10_away" in df.columns:
        df["diff_rolling_def_rating_10"] = df["rolling_def_rating_10_home"] - df["rolling_def_rating_10_away"]
    if "rolling_net_rating_10_home" in df.columns and "rolling_net_rating_10_away" in df.columns:
        df["diff_rolling_net_rating_10"] = df["rolling_net_rating_10_home"] - df["rolling_net_rating_10_away"]

    df.rename(
        columns={
            "rest_days_today_home": "rest_days_home",
            "rest_days_today_away": "rest_days_away",
            "is_back_to_back_today_home": "is_back_to_back_home",
            "is_back_to_back_today_away": "is_back_to_back_away",
        },
        inplace=True,
    )

    feature_cols = [
        "rolling_win_rate_10_home",
        "rolling_win_rate_10_away",
        "rolling_point_diff_10_home",
        "rolling_point_diff_10_away",
        "season_win_rate_home",
        "season_win_rate_away",
        "season_point_diff_avg_home",
        "season_point_diff_avg_away",
        "rest_days_home",
        "rest_days_away",
        "is_back_to_back_home",
        "is_back_to_back_away",
        "elo_like_home",
        "elo_like_away",
        "diff_rolling_win_rate_10",
        "diff_rolling_point_diff_10",
        "diff_season_win_rate",
        "diff_season_point_diff_avg",
        "diff_elo_like",
        "rolling_win_rate_5_home",
        "rolling_win_rate_5_away",
        "rolling_point_diff_5_home",
        "rolling_point_diff_5_away",
        "diff_rolling_win_rate_5",
        "diff_rolling_point_diff_5",
        "is_4in6_home",
        "is_4in6_away",
        "diff_is_4in6",


    ]

    extra_cols = [
        "rolling_off_rating_10_home",
        "rolling_off_rating_10_away",
        "rolling_def_rating_10_home",
        "rolling_def_rating_10_away",
        "rolling_net_rating_10_home",
        "rolling_net_rating_10_away",
        "diff_rolling_off_rating_10",
        "diff_rolling_def_rating_10",
        "diff_rolling_net_rating_10",
    ]
    for c in extra_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            feature_cols.append(c)

    feature_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c in df.columns]
    
    # ✅ 표준 ABBR 강제 생성/보정 (dict에서 뽑은 abbr이든, full_name이든 무조건 30팀 ABBR로)
    tg["home_team_abbr_std"] = tg.get("home_team_abbr", None)
    tg["away_team_abbr_std"] = tg.get("away_team_abbr", None)

    tg["home_team_abbr_std"] = tg["home_team_abbr_std"].apply(to_abbr)
    tg["away_team_abbr_std"] = tg["away_team_abbr_std"].apply(to_abbr)

    # abbr이 비었으면 team full name으로 한번 더 채움
    tg.loc[tg["home_team_abbr_std"].isna(), "home_team_abbr_std"] = tg.loc[
        tg["home_team_abbr_std"].isna(), "home_team"
    ].apply(to_abbr)

    tg.loc[tg["away_team_abbr_std"].isna(), "away_team_abbr_std"] = tg.loc[
        tg["away_team_abbr_std"].isna(), "away_team"
    ].apply(to_abbr)

    print("[DEBUG][TODAY] std abbr null rate:",
        tg["home_team_abbr_std"].isna().mean(),
        tg["away_team_abbr_std"].isna().mean())
    
    
    

    # -----------------------------
    # ✅ FINAL today_df (KEEP ABBR)
    # -----------------------------
    base_cols = ["game_id", "date", "season", "home_team", "away_team"]

    # ✅ odds 매칭은 무조건 std를 쓰자
    for c in ["home_team_abbr_std", "away_team_abbr_std"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            base_cols.append(c)

    
    today_df = df[base_cols + feature_cols].copy()


    # ✅ 오늘은 target이 없으니까, feature 결측만 평균으로 채우면 됨
    for c in feature_cols:
        today_df[c] = pd.to_numeric(today_df[c], errors="coerce")

    fill_map = {c: float(today_df[c].mean()) for c in feature_cols}
    today_df = today_df.fillna(fill_map)

    # 마지막으로, feature_cols 중 여전히 NaN(전부 NaN이던 컬럼)은 0으로
    today_df = today_df.fillna(0.0)

    return today_df, feature_cols
